msg.welcome.title: Welcome to the firm
msg.welcome.body: Fund III starts investing today. $750M in commitments and an empty portfolio. Find companies for sale on the map, sign NDAs, run diligence and take deals to IC.
msg.rate_changed.title: Policy rate {to}
msg.phase_changed.title: Economic phase: {to}
msg.sale_early_notice.title: {company}: preparing for sale
msg.sale_early_notice.body: The owner told you first. Reason: {reason}. No advisor has been hired yet, so you can offer exclusivity.
msg.sale_started.title: {company}: teaser out
msg.sale_started.body: The sale process has opened. Reason: {reason}.
msg.sale_withdrawn.title: {company}: sale withdrawn
msg.sale_withdrawn.body: The owner pulled the process as the market turned down.
msg.sale_failed.title: {company}: sale failed
msg.sale_failed.body: No bid met the seller's price. It will stay off the market for a while.
msg.rival_deal.title: {buyer} acquires {company}
msg.auction_lost.title: {company}: auction lost
msg.diligence_report.title: {company}: {stream} diligence report
msg.diligence_report.found: Found: {issues}. The full report is in the deal room.
msg.diligence_report.clean: No material issue. The full report is in the deal room.
msg.committee_decision.title: {company}: {outcome} by IC
msg.committee_decision.body: See each partner's view in the deal room.
msg.deal_closed.title: {company} acquired
msg.deal_broken.title: {company}: deal broken
msg.deal_broken.body: The funding needed to close could not be put together.
msg.initiative_done.title: {company}: {kind} complete
msg.initiative_done.body: The effect shows from next month's results.
msg.issue_surfaced.title: {company}: {issue}
msg.issue_surfaced.body: A problem diligence missed has surfaced. Decide when to tell IC.
msg.strike.title: {company}: strike
msg.strike.body: Production has stopped. Settle with a wage increase, or hold out and wait for a return to work.
msg.covenant_breach.title: {company}: covenant breach
msg.covenant_breach.body: Leverage {leverage} (limit {max}), interest cover {cover}. A cure takes {cure}. Three breaches in a row and the lenders take the company.
msg.lenders_took_keys.title: {company}: the lenders took the keys
msg.lenders_took_keys.body: The equity is a total loss.
msg.refinanced.title: {company}: refinancing
msg.recap_paid.title: {company}: dividend recap
msg.recap_paid.body: Raised {amount} of new debt and paid it out as a dividend.
msg.add_on_closed.title: {company}: add-on of {target}
msg.exit_offer.title: {company}: {route} offer
msg.exit_pulled.title: {company}: {route} pulled
msg.exit_closed.title: {company} exited
msg.proceeds_received.title: Remaining proceeds received
msg.quarter_report.title: Quarterly LP report
msg.investment_period_ended.title: Investment period over
msg.investment_period_ended.body: No new platforms can be bought. Only add-ons and exits remain.
msg.fund_term_ended.title: End of fund term
msg.next_fund.title: Next fund raised
msg.next_fund.own: The first fund raised under your own name. Commitments {committed}.
msg.promotion.title: Promotion: {rank}
msg.promotion.body: Your attention, concurrent deal limit and carry share have gone up.
msg.fired.title: Contract ended
msg.fired.body: The firm did not renew your contract.
msg.final_round.title: {company}: final round
msg.final_round.body: You are #{rank} of {bidders} bidders. Before the deadline you can raise up to 105% of the IC-approved price.
msg.regulator_blocked.title: {company}: blocked by regulators
msg.regulator_blocked.body: The deal did not clear foreign investment review. It is off, and no capital was called.
msg.achievement_unlocked.title: Achievement: {name}
msg.objectives_review.title: Annual objectives: {met}/{total} met
msg.event.earnout_dispute.title: {company}: earnout dispute
msg.event.earnout_dispute.body: The former owner is claiming {amount} in additional consideration. The dispute is over revenue recognition.
msg.event.team_poaching.title: {company}: key executive being poached
msg.event.team_poaching.body: A competitor has made an offer to the head of operations.
msg.event.plant_outage.title: {company}: plant outage
msg.event.plant_outage.body: The main line is down. A proper repair costs {amount}.
msg.event.customer_renegotiation.title: {company}: major customer wants a price cut
msg.event.customer_renegotiation.body: The largest customer wants a discount as a condition of renewal.
msg.event.cost_shock.title: {company}: cost shock
msg.event.cost_shock.body: Costs have jumped across the sector. Decide whether to pass them on in prices or absorb them in margin.
msg.event.cyber_incident.title: {company}: security incident
msg.event.cyber_incident.body: Customer data may have leaked. The response costs {amount}.
msg.event.incentive_plan.title: {company}: management incentive request
msg.event.incentive_plan.body: The CEO has asked for 5% of the equity for management.
msg.event.repricing_window.title: {company}: repricing window
msg.event.repricing_window.body: Credit markets have eased. For a fee of {amount} the spread can be reset to today's level.
msg.event.co_invest_request.title: {company}: LP co-investment request
msg.event.co_invest_request.body: An investor wants to buy one-fifth of the equity ({amount}) alongside the fund at the same price.
event.plant_outage.first.effect: Pay for the repair. One lost month, then back to normal
event.plant_outage.second.effect: Revenue ↓ for 3 months, partial recovery, margin −0.3 pts
event.cost_shock.first.effect: Growth ↓ for 6 months (half with a brand)
event.cyber_incident.second.effect: 30% chance it leaks: cost doubles, reputation −5
event.repricing_window.first.effect: Pay the fee and reset the spread to market
event.co_invest_request.first.effect: Fund equity and ownership go to 80%. LP satisfaction ↑
achievement.double_up.detail: Exited at a MOIC of 2x or more.
achievement.triple_up.detail: Exited at a MOIC of 3x or more.
achievement.home_run.detail: Exited at a MOIC of 5x or more.
achievement.roll_up.detail: Sold a platform with 3 or more add-ons.
achievement.clean_sheet.detail: Ran all 4 diligence streams and sold at 1.5x or more with no surprises.
achievement.turnaround.detail: Bought a distressed company and sold it at 2x.
achievement.comeback_kid.detail: Sold a company that needed an equity cure at 1.5x or more.
achievement.recession_buyer.detail: Acquired a company in a recession.
achievement.big_game.detail: Closed a deal at an enterprise value of $300M or more.
achievement.top_of_the_table.detail: Ranked first among the firms with 2 or more exits.
achievement.own_name.detail: Raised a fund under your own name.
achievement.cross_border.detail: Acquired a company outside the US.
achievement.take_private.detail: Bought a public company and took it private.
msg.owner_opened.title: {company}: the owner will talk
msg.owner_opened.body: Four months of talks alone. Reason: {reason}. Without an agreement by then, an adviser is hired and it goes to auction.
msg.owner_declined.title: {company}: the owner said no
msg.owner_declined.body: They are not selling now. You can raise it again in a year.
msg.rival_approach.title: {company}: {house} has made a proposal
msg.rival_approach.body: The owner told you directly. They will answer within three months. At relationship 40 you can counter now.
msg.lost_to_rival.title: {company}: gone to {house}
msg.lost_to_rival.body: The owner accepted {house}. Price {ev}. The relationship you built is gone.
msg.rival_rebuffed.title: {company}: the owner sent {house} away
msg.rival_rebuffed.body: The proposal was turned down. The company stays with its owner.
msg.house_fundraised.title: {house} closes a {size} fund
msg.house_fundraised.body: Fresh money. For a year it bids higher.
msg.house_partner_left.title: {house} loses a senior partner
msg.house_partner_left.body: The deal team is unsettled. For a year its bids are weaker.
msg.house_distress.title: {house} forced to sell {company}
msg.house_distress.body: The debt was too much. Lenders have put it on the market.
msg.owner_succeeded.title: {company}: {from} retires, {to} takes over
msg.owner_succeeded.body: You start again with the new owner. The relationship is halved.
msg.ceo_moved.title: {name} moves from {from} to {company}
msg.ceo_moved.body: Someone you know has changed desks. Half of what you built at {from} follows to {company}.
msg.teaser_received.title: {adviser}: teaser for {company}
msg.teaser_received.body: {format}. Sign the NDA for the memorandum. Give an indication before the deadline to make the shortlist.
msg.shortlisted.title: {company}: you are shortlisted
msg.shortlisted.body: {bidders} bidders go through. The data room and site visits are open. Take it to the committee and submit a binding bid.
msg.not_shortlisted.title: {company}: not shortlisted
msg.not_shortlisted.body: Your indication fell short, or none was given. The deal file is closed.
msg.bank_pitch.title: {adviser} introduces {company}
msg.bank_pitch.body: The owner is open to a sale. With the introduction you start at relationship 20.
